 ‘Yellowjackets’ Season 4 premiere red carpet: Melanie Lynskey, Christina Ricci, Jennifer Morrison and more 
 By 
 Mekhi Seabrook 
 Published 
 Nov. 11, 2026, 10:26 p.m. ET 
 Paramount+’s psychological thriller and drama “Yellowjackets” held it’s season 4 premiere at Paramount Pictures Studios on November 11, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. Melanie Lynskey, Christina Ricci, Jennifer Morrison, Sophie Nélisse and many more attened the celebration. Scroll through to see who all attended.
